question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
WITH unicorn_companies AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.company_id,
        cd.date_joined,
        ci.industry,
        cf.valuation
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON cd.company_id = cf.company_id
    WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
),
new_unicorns_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(uc.date_joined, 'T', 1) AS DATE)) AS year_joined,
        COUNT(*) AS new_unicorns
    FROM unicorn_companies uc
    WHERE uc.industry = 'Fintech'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(uc.date_joined, 'T', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY year_joined
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(new_unicorns) / 3.0, 2) AS avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM new_unicorns_by_year
